title: E-FRC-0059: the Koide amplitude b/a = sqrt(2) reduces exactly to a Z3 mass-coupling of 1/sqrt(2) = cos(45 degrees)...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0059 in the gauge arena: the Koide amplitude b/a = sqrt(2) reduces exactly to a Z3 mass-coupling of 1/sqrt(2) = cos(45 degrees), and that 45 degrees is the long-short root angle of the two-length (non-simply-laced) root families generally (B2 also has it, the cross control), with F4 being the theory instance (the long-long angle is 60 degrees, the control), locating the Koide sqrt(2) at the two-length root angle rather than as a free parameter.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
